technology_name: NEW ORGANIC FULLERENE DERIVATIVES FROM ELASTOMERS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Polymeric Material Synthesis / Solar Acceptor Material
problem_solved: Standard fullerene derivatives require toxic chemical additives and complex processing steps to extract, reducing operational yields and limiting organic solar cell efficiencies.
description: An eco-friendly synthesis method for extracting pure elastomer-fullerene derivatives without chemical additives by utilizing target electromagnetic wave irradiation, yielding an efficient, low-cost electron acceptor material.
applications: Organic solar cell electron acceptors, organic field-effect transistors (OFETs), organic Schottky diodes, and flexible organic memory systems.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
